india.one_line: India joins global AI supply chain protection efforts, while domestic regulators and startups advance AI adoption.

themes.title: India joins international AI supply chain accord
themes.text: India joined the US, Japan, and the UK in agreeing to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect them from China.

stories.headline: US and allies agree to create joint list to protect AI supply chains from China

themes.title: Bharat Semi secures seed funding for sensors
themes.text: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors by 2027.

stories.headline: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round for AI sensors

themes.title: SEBI plans AI guidelines for capital markets
themes.text: The Securities and Exchange Board of India announced upcoming guidelines for AI use in capital markets focusing on investor protection and human oversight.

stories.headline: Sebi to issue AI usage guidelines for capital markets focusing on investor protection
